paragraphs.text: In order to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace, you need to understand how to handle conflicts and reach agreements. Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion, but logic and reasoning are just as important. Before you can get somebody on-board with your goal, you should help them understand why they should pursue it. phrases.example: Either way, the result is the same. 无论哪种方式，结果一样。

phrases.meaning: 令人信服的、有说服力的；说服、使确信（convince 的现在分词）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：convincing（令人信服的，指论据、说法）/ convinced（确信的，指人，be convinced of/that）/ convincing 与 persuasive（persuasive 侧重「能打动人」）。
phrases.example: We persuade and get persuaded every day—we're either convincing or being convinced. 说服这事儿天天都在发生：不是你在劝别人，就是别人在劝你。

pitfalls: 被动语态的过去分词不能误写成过去式；不及物动词没有被动。
both...and / either...or / neither...nor 是固定配对，不能交叉混用。

questions.stem: What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph?

options.text: People may either be born with it or be able to cultivate it.
It proves crucial in making others follow one's course of action.
It refers to the natural and instinctive power of influencing one's coworkers.
People may view it as both a means to convince others and an art of communication.

questions.stem: Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace?

options.text: They enable employees to be convinced of their long-term gains.
They enable employees to trust their leaders unconditionally.
They help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal.
They help an organization to broaden its vision effectively.

questions.stem: What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace?

options.text: Acquire effective communication skills.
Avoid getting involved in conflicts with others.
Understand the reason for pursuing their goals.
Commit themselves fully to their ideas and plans.

questions.stem: When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers?

options.text: When they are convinced you work in their interests while sacrificing your own
When they become aware of the potential strength of the judgements you make
When they become aware of the meaningful relationships you keep with them.
When they are convinced they will make achievements together with you.

questions.stem: Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes?

options.text: To convince employees of the value of collaboration
To allow for the preferences of most people of today
To improve on traditional organizational structures
To adapt to employees' ever-changing working styles
